pr11.body:
PR10 was merged while its final audit addendum was in flight. A supplemental result-SHA ledger entry had omitted its path list. This documentation-only PR appends a complete superseding record, preserves the original audit history, and reconciles the observed PR10/PR9 merges and branch cleanup.

**AC5 verification itself is complete and merged.** The unchanged implementation passed locally and in exact merged-head CI:120 passed, zero failures/errors, five unchanged S6 skips, real exit0. All seven selected controls and six original S1 cases pass. This follow-up changes no application, test, design, schema, dependency, workflow or gate; all107 frozen hashes remain identical.

- [Post-publication proof](https://github.com/ga424/communityconnect/blob/f80f4d7aefd65b8dd3db960c4ebeab2f588603f4/docs/evidence/ac5/post-publication.json)
- [AC5 evidence and review checklist](https://github.com/ga424/communityconnect/blob/f80f4d7aefd65b8dd3db960c4ebeab2f588603f4/docs/evidence/ac5/README.md)
- [Merged-head CI42450702977](https://github.com/ga424/communityconnect/actions/runs/42450702977) at722f1ba9bdd42125665ad51f5ecbc6414f7ad07a; downloaded JUnit reverified
- [COMC-58](https://gkms.atlassian.net/browse/COMC-58)

PR10 merged at b41387f1c63c0b469b2c17026095c47d43932011 by GitHub account abreugus; the assistant did not invoke that merge. GitHub also marked PR9 merged and removed its remote branch; its clean local branch was deleted. The in-flight addendum briefly recreated verify/COMC-58-ac5 after automatic deletion. That ref was renamed remotely and locally to docs/COMC-58-audit-followup, preserving the unmerged commit and removing the merged branch name. This audit checkout starts from merged main and retains the correction as ancestry. No unmerged work was discarded.

Validation:107 frozen hashes, main ledger prefixes, AISE structure, source guard and whitespace pass. The validator still reports the retained incomplete supplemental record because it scans historical lines; the complete superseding record provides current traceability. Historical EV-REPO-ROOT and TestClient warnings remain. No control was weakened.

The localhost preview remains running. Named acceptance and full-story/course reviews are not inferred from platform merge events. Automatic post-merge deletion remains enabled. This PR is open for audit review; no merge or next feature is authorized. Its exact final CI/commit proof will be appended in Git provenance notes without further branch edits.
